description: The file defines a Marketing model class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It provides methods for managing marketing records in the database, including CRUD operations, fetching reports, and filtering capabilities. The class extends the system's base Model class and interacts with related database tables such as 'marketing' and 'marketing_report'.

classes.name: Marketing
classes.description: A model class for managing marketing campaigns, including CRUD operations, report management, and retrieval with filtering support.

methods.name: addMarketing
methods.description: Creates a new marketing record in the database with the provided data.

methods.name: editMarketing
methods.description: Updates an existing marketing record identified by marketing_id with new data.

methods.name: deleteMarketing
methods.description: Deletes a marketing record and its associated reports from the database.

methods.name: getMarketing
methods.description: Retrieves a marketing record by its marketing_id.

methods.name: getMarketingByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a marketing record by its unique code.

methods.name: getMarketings
methods.description: Fetches multiple marketing records based on optional filters such as name, code, date range, with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalMarketings
methods.description: Returns the total count of marketing records matching optional filters.

methods.name: deleteReports
methods.description: Deletes all marketing report records associated with a given marketing_id.

methods.name: getReports
methods.description: Retrieves marketing report entries for a specific marketing_id with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalReports
methods.description: Returns the total number of marketing report entries for a specific marketing_id.
